ups-amazon-glide-down.n: UPS Amazon cutback and network overhaul
ups-amazon-glide-down.s: UPS has finished cutting Amazon volume and reconfiguring its network after announcing job cuts and building closures.

beats.h403: UPS opened 2024 with 12,000 job cuts aimed at about $1 billion in savings, after fourth-quarter revenue fell 7.8%.
beats.h503: Then came the big one: UPS would cut Amazon volume by more than half. Amazon was its largest customer, at nearly 12% of revenue.
beats.h511: In April, UPS put numbers on the Amazon pullback: about 20,000 jobs and 73 buildings, aiming for another $1 billion in savings.

cx.intro: UPS is shrinking its Amazon business and its own network at once. Shippers should know what that means for capacity and costs.
cx.now: The cutback is complete. UPS reports quarterly earnings Oct. 27, and its Teamsters contract runs until July 31, 2028.

fedex-freight-spin.s: FedEx has named leaders for the Freight spin-off, which was on track for June 2026.

beats.h433: Freight is the largest U.S. LTL carrier, with $9.4B in fiscal 2024 revenue. FedEx had been reviewing its fit since June 2024.
beats.h519: John A. Smith is future CEO and R. Brad Martin chairman; a confidential Form 10 went in Aug. 2025, with FDXF as the ticker.

cx.intro: FedEx is spinning off FedEx Freight, the largest U.S. LTL carrier, into its own public company.
cx.now: Leaders are named and the separation is still expected by June 2026, with FDXF as the planned ticker.

fedex-network-2.s: Earlier coverage says FedEx expects the U.S. rollout of merged Ground and Express pickup and delivery to be complete by the end of 2027.

cx.intro: FedEx is folding Ground and Express into one network, and shippers feel it in service, pickup routes and pricing.

usps-air-cargo.n: USPS air cargo shifts from FedEx to UPS
usps-air-cargo.s: UPS took over USPS domestic air cargo from FedEx as the FedEx contract expired.

cx.intro: USPS moved its domestic air cargo from FedEx to UPS, a shift that hit FedEx's profit outlook and reshuffled who flies the mail.
cx.now: The handover is done. Next on the clock: UPS reports earnings Oct. 27 and FedEx Oct. 28.

de-minimis.n: End of the de minimis exemption
de-minimis.s: De minimis has ended for all countries, and carriers report a trade hit while postal services suspended U.S. shipments.

beats.h420: The idea started with volume: the White House said de minimis shipments grew from about 140 million to over 1 billion a year.
beats.h504: USPS stopped taking China and Hong Kong parcels, then reversed a day later and said it would work with CBP on collecting the new duties.

cx.intro: The $800 duty-free exemption for small imports is gone, so low-value parcels now face duties and new paperwork.
cx.now: De minimis is closed to every country. FedEx reports quarterly earnings on Oct. 28 and UPS on Oct. 27, so there may be more to learn about the impact.

tariff-refunds.s: Refunds are flowing to importers, with the U.S. Treasury having paid out about $22 billion in May and $49.2 billion in June, and Amazon is now facing consolidated consumer lawsuits over how it handles its share.

cx.intro: After the Supreme Court struck down IEEPA tariffs, refunds are starting to flow, and shippers want to know who gets paid and when.
cx.now: CBP's current capability covers roughly $11.4 billion, or 6.9%, of IEEPA tariffs; UPS reports earnings Oct. 27 and FedEx Oct. 28.

carrier-gri.s: FedEx set a 5.9% increase for Jan. 4, 2027 and DHL set 5.9% for Jan. 1, while UPS has not yet announced its 2027 rates.

beats.h401: FedEx's 2024 increase averaged 5.9%, matching UPS, which started Dec. 26, 2023. Both were down from 6.9% the year before.
beats.h424: DHL Express matched the 5.9% for U.S. accounts, effective Jan. 1, 2025, with some service and surcharge changes too.
beats.h426: UPS matched FedEx at 5.9% but started two weeks earlier than the year before, on Dec. 23, 2024.
beats.h529: FedEx stayed at 5.9% for 2026. Surcharges rose too: residential delivery went to $6.95 from $6.55.
beats.02: DHL Express matches the 5.9% again, effective Jan 1, 2027. It will change a limited number of services and surcharges but did not list them.
beats.07: UPS hasn't announced yet. In recent years it has followed FedEx by two to three weeks and matched the 5.9% headline.

cx.intro: Carriers raise list rates every January, and 5.9% has been the average headline figure for years. Shippers care what's beneath it.
cx.now: DHL starts Jan. 1 and FedEx Jan. 4; UPS has yet to announce. UPS reports earnings Oct. 27 and FedEx Oct. 28.

usps-pricing.s: USPS has put holiday package prices into effect after a series of annual and mid-year increases.

beats.h402: The year opened with a Jan. 21 increase: Ground Advantage rose 5.4%, Priority Mail 5.7% and Express 5.9%. None of them changed in July.
beats.h409: In May, USPS proposed a 25% average Parcel Select jump for July 14, while Ground Advantage, Priority Mail and Express stayed flat.
beats.h430: By November, USPS proposed another round for Jan. 19, 2025: Ground Advantage 3.9%, and Parcel Select 9.2% on top of July's 25%.
beats.h516: In May 2025, governors approved July 13 hikes: Ground Advantage 7.1%, Priority Mail 6.3%, Parcel Select 7.6%. Express held flat.

cx.intro: USPS has raised package prices in steps since 2024, and holiday pricing is the latest layer shippers have to budget for.

peak-surcharges.s: Peak surcharges are billing at the major carriers, and an industry analysis now projects record-high parcel rates for Q4 2026.

import-export-fees.s: FedEx added per-pound demand fees on U.S. imports and raised export fees, following UPS's earlier surge fees.

cx.intro: UPS and FedEx are now both adding per-pound fees on international express, which raises the cost of heavier imports and exports.
cx.now: FedEx's fees run until further notice. UPS reports earnings Oct. 27 and FedEx Oct. 28, and peak surcharges at major carriers end Jan. 15, 2027.

usps-leadership.s: Steiner remains Postmaster General and addressed postal customer councils in an official USPS video in early October 2026.

beats.h506: DeJoy announced his exit, and Deputy Postmaster General Doug Tulino stepped in as acting chief while the Board of Governors searched.
beats.h515: The Board picked former Waste Management CEO David Steiner, a FedEx board member who said he'd leave that board before joining USPS.

cx.now: Steiner is still Postmaster General and spoke to postal customer councils by video in early October 2026. The Amazon same-day pilot expands Oct. 20.

usps-service-network.n: USPS service standards and processing changes
usps-service-network.s: USPS has lengthened delivery estimates for Priority Mail and Ground Advantage to and from Alaska, Hawaii, U.S. territories and several Pacific nations, effective Oct. 1, 2026.

cx.now: The longer estimates took effect Oct. 1. Separately, USPS has set a Dec. 17 Ground Advantage deadline for Christmas delivery.

usps-finances.s: The PRC says USPS package volume fell 6% in fiscal 2025 while package revenue held flat, after a $9.5 billion fiscal 2024 loss.

cx.intro: USPS lost billions while its package business shifted; shippers watch it because USPS also does last-mile for other carriers.

parcel-volume-amazon.n: Amazon's rise to top U.S. parcel carrier
parcel-volume-amazon.s: Amazon is now the largest U.S. carrier by volume, in a market of about 23 to 24 billion parcels in 2025.

beats.h408: Amazon Logistics grew 15.7% to 5.9 billion parcels in 2023, passing UPS at 4.6 billion. USPS still led at 6.6 billion.
beats.h522: In 2024, USPS held 31% of volume and Amazon 28%. Pitney Bowes projected Amazon would pass USPS by 2028.
beats.r03: Pitney Bowes also has Amazon first, at 6.9 billion parcels to USPS's 6.2 billion. By revenue, UPS (31.6%) and FedEx (30.8%) lead.

cx.intro: How Amazon climbed to No. 1 in U.S. parcel volume, while UPS and FedEx still lead on revenue.
cx.now: Amazon leads on volume, UPS and FedEx on revenue. Peak fees start Oct. 24, and UPS and FedEx report earnings Oct. 27 and 28.

usps-big-shipper-deals.n: USPS deals with Amazon and DHL eCommerce
usps-big-shipper-deals.s: USPS signed an exclusive last-mile deal with DHL eCommerce and is piloting same-day delivery for Amazon.

beats.21: Reports said Amazon would cut its USPS volume by two-thirds; the new agreement trims it by about 20% instead.
beats.g09: DHL eCommerce's 19 automated hubs feed USPS's 170 million-plus delivery points, and Amazon's roughly 80% stays in that network.
beats.09: Amazon drops a second batch at select post offices between noon and 1 p.m. for delivery by 8 p.m., capped at 200 packages a day per site.

cx.intro: USPS is reshaping its two big parcel relationships, with Amazon and DHL eCommerce, and shippers rely on its network.
cx.now: The same-day pilot adds Columbia, S.C. on Oct 20 with a 500-package cap; USPS holiday prices end Jan 15.

amazon-network-buildout.n: Amazon's push to deliver for everyone
amazon-network-buildout.s: Amazon has widened its logistics offer to outside businesses, and a report now says a national delivery service is close to launching.

beats.h512: Amazon started by building out its own reach: $4 billion by the end of 2026 to take its rural footprint to more than 200 delivery stations.

cx.now: A launch is reported as close but not dated. UPS and FedEx report earnings Oct. 27 and 28, and FedEx's 5.9% rate increase starts Jan. 4.

drone-delivery.n: Drone delivery scale-up and FAA Part 108
drone-delivery.s: Amazon's Westborough drone hub is listed as in review and faces a new town bylaw, a zoning appeal and a planning hearing, while the FAA's Part 108 rule was unpublished as of early October.

beats.a60770e8e9c32: Wing and Walmart are targeting Denver and Seattle in 2027, which would take them to nearly 20 metros and more than 270 Walmart stores.

cx.intro: Drone delivery is scaling up while the FAA rule meant to make it routine is still unpublished. Shippers should watch both.
cx.now: As of Oct. 9, Part 108 was still unpublished, so BVLOS delivery runs on waivers or Part 135 certificates. The FCC votes on 800 MHz drone use Oct. 29.

amazon-labor.n: Amazon driver labor and NLRB disputes
amazon-labor.s: An NLRB judge approved an Amazon DSP settlement without a joint-employer finding, and former drivers have sued Amazon and a closed contractor.

cx.intro: Fights over who employs Amazon's delivery drivers could shape labor costs and risk across the delivery network shippers rely on.

delivery-robot-rules.s: San Jose approved delivery robot regulations, and officials will evaluate fleet data over nine months before returning to the council next fall to decide on the rules' future.

royal-mail-dm26.s: The CWU has paused further rollout of DM26 and is calling for an agreed plan to fix delivery offices where it is not working as intended.

cbp-low-value-import-filing.s: CBP's proposal, published Oct. 8, is open for public comment through Dec. 7, with no effective date stated.

ups-parcel-pivot.s: Analysts and consultants remain split on whether UPS's logistics focus signals a retreat from B2C parcels, with UPS officials saying small package is not going away.

de-minimis-end.s: De minimis is suspended for all countries since August 2025, and the commercial shipment exemption is set to be repealed from July 1, 2027, according to the article.

last-mile-facility-legislation.s: The bill is laid over in committee with 35 co-sponsors, and no committee vote has been scheduled, according to the council's website.

beats.a17304bde0800: Organizers are pressing for a vote: 33 of 51 Councilmembers cosponsor the bill, yet nothing has moved since an April committee hearing.

cx.now: The bill has not been called for a vote. Organizers have a canvass set for Oct. 17 and a City Hall rally set for Oct. 22.

uniuni-delivery-complaints.s: UniUni said it is working with local Tacoma delivery service providers after residents' complaints, which a group of neighbors has also sent to the Washington Attorney General's office.

robot-biometric-suits.s: Two Cook County lawsuits filed against Coco Robotics and Serve Robotics over alleged biometric scanning; both companies dispute the claims.

ups-driver-choice-lawsuit.s: UPS and the Teamsters settled on April 5, 2026, and LawFold.com found no newer ruling or settlement development as of October 14, 2026.

uniuni-mak-acquisition.s: MAK terminated the UniUni purchase agreement on Oct. 20, 2026 and is withdrawing its preliminary prospectus, saying it reserves all rights.
